points.text: The core of preserving the Imams' matter involves concealing esoteric knowledge from the unqualified and narrating only what the audience already knows to avoid being considered liars.

Spreading the Imams' traditions indiscriminately is equated with denying their right or causing spiritual and physical affliction, whereas concealing difficult parts brings honor and divine protection.
The Imams possess secret knowledge revealed sequentially from Allah to Gabriel to Muhammad to Ali, which is currently being exposed publicly in the streets by their followers.
The Imams would reveal specific knowledge to every individual if they could find the truly pious among the people, indicating a distinction between general and specific concealment.
